items.description: Host must provide the Services agreed in each applicable Service Order, and Client must receive them.
items.span_text: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Host shall provide to Client, and Client shall receive from Host, the Services agreed in each of the applicable Service Orders.

items.description: Host may only incur pay-per-use fees not listed in the Service Order after obtaining Client's prior written approval.
items.span_text: Fees charged on a pay-per-use basis and not set out in the Service Order may only be incurred after prior written approval of Client.

items.description: Client is responsible for sales or use taxes imposed on separately invoiced services, based on its percentage split of Gross Profit if applicable.
items.span_text: Client shall be responsible for any and all sales or use taxes which may be imposed on such services, based on the Client’s percentage split of Gross Profit if applicable.

items.description: Client must deliver each batch of Colocation Servers to Host's Data Center Facility, FOB destination.
items.span_text: Client will deliver the Colocation Servers, including the respective batch of Colocation Servers, to Host, FOB destination, Host’s Data Center Facility.

items.description: Client must pay Host Delayed Compensation based on hours and number of servers delayed, plus other sums due, if shipment is late.
items.span_text: Host shall be entitled to payment from the Client for the corresponding Delayed Compensation in accordance with the corresponding number of hours and number of Colocation Servers delayed and any other compensation, expenses, fees, charges, or other sums which may be due Host by Client; and
items.trigger: in the event that Client fails to ship the respective batch of Colocation Servers before or within ten (10) calendar days of each batch shipment date

items.description: Host may terminate the Agreement by notice with immediate effect if Client does not remedy the shipment delay within thirty calendar days.
items.span_text: if Client fails to remedy such delay within thirty (30) calendar days, Host shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement by notice with immediate effect.
items.trigger: if Client fails to remedy such delay within thirty (30) calendar days

items.anchor_event: the earlier of (i) the delivery of Colocation Servers, or (ii) from the termination of this Agreement
items.description: Client must remit all Delayed Compensation to Host within seven Business Days after the earlier of delivery of the servers or termination.
items.span_text: Client shall unconditionally remit to Host all Delayed Compensation within seven (7) Business Days upon the earlier of (i) the delivery of Colocation Servers, or (ii) from the termination of this Agreement, unless otherwise stipulated in the Agreement.

items.description: Client must prepare servers for safe and lawful shipment, ship FOB via the agreed carrier, with appropriate documentation.
items.span_text: All Colocation Servers shall be properly prepared for safe and lawful shipment by Client, shall be shipped FOB to the Host Data Center Facility via the common carrier mutually agreed upon by the Parties, and shall be accompanied by appropriate transportation and other agreed upon documentation.

items.description: Client bears all shipping costs for the Client Assets, including freight, insurance, taxes, customs and duties.
items.span_text: Client shall be responsible for all costs and expenses associated with shipping the Client Assets, including but not limited to freight, insurance, taxes, customs, and duties.

items.description: Client must promptly replace, at its own expense, any Client Assets lost, damaged or delayed in shipping.
items.span_text: In the event that any Colocation Servers are lost, damaged, or delayed during shipping, Client shall promptly replace the affected Client Assets at its own expense.
items.trigger: In the event that any Colocation Servers are lost, damaged, or delayed during shipping

items.anchor_event: delivery of the relevant batch to Host
items.description: Host must connect the facility to power and bring it to standard operating conditions for each batch within twenty calendar days of delivery.
items.span_text: Host shall, to the satisfaction of Client, connect (1) the Data Center Facility to electrical power, and (2) enable the Data Center Facility to reach its standard operational conditions for the respective batch of Colocation Servers within twenty (20) calendar days of delivery of the relevant batch to Host (“Installation Period”).

items.description: Host must pay Client Delayed Compensation based on hours and number of servers delayed if the power-on conditions are not met on time.
items.span_text: Host shall be liable to pay to Client the corresponding Delayed Compensation in accordance with the corresponding number of hours and number of Colocation Servers delayed.
items.trigger: In the event that either of the conditions set forth in Article 3.6(c)(i) fails to be satisfied on time

items.description: Client may terminate the Agreement by notice with immediate effect if the power-on conditions remain unmet for more than thirty calendar days.
items.span_text: Client shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement by notice with immediate effect.
items.trigger: In the event that either of the conditions set forth in Article 3.6(c)(i) fails to be satisfied for more than thirty (30) calendar days

items.anchor_event: the eartlier of (i) satisfaction of the conditions set forth in Article 3.6(c)(i), or (ii) from the termination of this Agreement
items.description: Host must remit all Delayed Compensation to Client within seven Business Days after the earlier of satisfaction of the power-on conditions or termination.
items.span_text: Host shall unconditionally remit to Client all Delayed Compensation within seven (7) Business Days upon the eartlier of (i) satisfaction of the conditions set forth in Article 3.6(c)(i), or (ii) from the termination of this Agreement, unless otherwise stipulated in the Agreement.

items.anchor_event: estimated power-on date for each batch of Colocation Servers
items.description: Client must pay a Prepayment to Host fifteen Business Days before the estimated power-on date for each batch of servers.
items.span_text: Client shall pay a prepayment to Host (the “Prepayment”) fifteen (15) Business Days prior to the estimated power-on date for each batch of Colocation Servers as calculated and set forth in the applicable Service Order.

items.description: The Prepayment must be kept at the level required in the Service Order, with immediate top-up payments if it falls below the required amount.
items.span_text: Host shall maintain the Prepayment at the level required in the Service Order during the Term of the Agreement at all times and shall immediately make payments to Host to increase the Prepayment to the required amount if the amount of the Prepayment falls below the required amount.
items.trigger: if the amount of the Prepayment falls below the required amount

items.description: Host may use the Prepayment only to pay power costs incurred by Client under the Power Purchase Agreement or to offset the final Power Reimbursement.
items.span_text: Host may use a Prepayment to only prepay or pay power costs incurred by the Client as required under the Power Purchase Agreement, or to offset the finally determined Power Reimbursement of the corresponding batch of Colocation Servers

items.anchor_event: termination or expiration of this Agreement
items.description: Host must return any unused Prepayment in full to Client within seven Business Days after termination or expiration, or later once it receives payment from its power supplier.
items.span_text: If there is any unused Prepayment at the expiration or termination of this Agreement, Host shall unconditionally return such unused Prepayment in full to Client within seven (7) Business Days from the termination or expiration of this Agreement
items.trigger: If there is any unused Prepayment at the expiration or termination of this Agreement
